content: {"reasoning": "CO-197 is prior authorization missing at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal was already filed and the denial stands. There is no valid action to progress collection from the payer, and the patient share doesn't count toward the objective since the whole denial is a provider auth failure. The balance is uncollectible from the payer.", "action": "write_off"}
